title: How Education Entitlement Is Charged, Exhausted and Restored
content:
**Education Procedures, Part 5 — Charging entitlement (Education Benefits (GI Bill and Dependents' Education)).**

**5.01 Charge for a certified term.** Entitlement is charged for every day of a certified term.
- Under the rate-of-pursuit basis (the Post-9/11 GI Bill levels) each day is charged at the rate of pursuit: a term at 75 percent rate of pursuit is charged 0.75 day per day, rounded to the whole day for the term.
- Under the training-time basis (Chapter 30, Chapter 35 and Chapter 1606) each day is charged at 1 for full time, 0.75 for three-quarter time, 0.5 for half time and 0.25 for less than half time.

**5.02 Condition.** Entitlement is charged only on a benefit whose status is active, as the benefit record shows before the charge.

**5.03 Entitlement running out during a term.** When entitlement runs out partway through a term, a Post-9/11 GI Bill student is paid to the end of that term. The further clause "while a flat-rate chapter stops paying on the day entitlement runs out" is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for flat-rate payments when entitlement runs out.

**5.04 Exhaustion and reactivation.** A benefit becomes exhausted when its last day of entitlement is charged. Entitlement charged for a term interrupted by a school closure or a program disapproval is restored where the tier provides for that restoration (every tier does), and an exhausted benefit becomes usable again by that restoration.

**5.05 Advance certification.** Schools may certify a term up to 120 days before the term starts.

**5.06 Charging illustrations (hypothetical 100-day terms).**

| Basis | Training load | Charge per day | Days charged for the term |
|---|---|---|---|
| Rate of pursuit | 75 percent | 0.75 | 75 |
| Rate of pursuit | 100 percent | 1 | 100 |
| Training time | Full time | 1 | 100 |
| Training time | Three-quarter time | 0.75 | 75 |
| Training time | Half time | 0.5 | 50 |
| Training time | Less than half time | 0.25 | 25 |

**5.07 Status illustration.** A charge proposed on a benefit that is exhausted, delimited or relinquished is not made under 5.02; once a school-closure restoration returns days to an exhausted benefit, the benefit is active again and can be charged.
